Repo: /workspace/SuperGrok1.5, branch claude/h100-audit-maximal. H100 sm_90. SOLE builder. Current: 30/33 L3-TC (verified; decoder 11/11, vit 11/11, mamba 8/11).

TASK: the FINAL 3 cells, all mamba SG-family — **SG11/mamba (supergrok), SG15/mamba (supergrok15), SG2/mamba (supergrok2)**. Port the now-existing decoder/vit SG cells to mamba, leveraging that the shared mamba-forward race was JUST FIXED (commit 0b57f7e — register-pressure wgmma-accumulator A/A/A race; it un-dormanted prodigy + looksam on mamba). Target 30 -> up to 33/33.

PRIORITY 1 — **SG11/mamba + SG15/mamba** (the tractable port -> 32/33): the SAM 2nd-pass is now LIVE on mamba (looksam/mamba, un-dormanted by 0b57f7e) and the SG11/15 sharpness + meta-net mu stage exists on decoder/vit (commit 422ff1f). Port it to fused_mamba_megakernel.cuh: mirror (a) looksam/mamba for the SAM 2nd-pass on the mamba forward, and (b) SG11/15 decoder/vit for sharpness=(g_sam-g)^2 + the per-tensor meta-net mu. Route in dispatch.py (_FUSED_L3_REAL/_L3_WGMMA_CELLS) + the mamba launcher cases (mega_mamba_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu). The race-fix should cover the SAM double-forward — VERIFY A/A/A bit-determinism; if it STILL fails A/A/A, the fix didn't cover the SG path → report + land dormant (don't ship non-deterministic).

PRIORITY 2 — **SG2/mamba** (the hard one -> 33/33): port the SG2 composition (in-kernel segmented sort STAGE -1 + the meta-net AS the optimizer phase, commit 66b0f97 / spec at /workspace/.sg2_spec.md) onto the mamba megakernel. Hardest — the sort + full CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta-net + the SAM double-forward on mamba. VERIFY A/A/A; if it re-trips the race (the SG2 builder flagged this), land it DORMANT + document — 32/33 with an honestly-dormant SG2/mamba is a fine stopping point if it resists.

CAVEATS (carry honestly): SG11/15 mamba won't grok on L3 (meta-net untrained — that's a separate owner-approved task, do NOT do the host-training here); SG2/mamba won't grok (CSA idx_UQ fidelity gap). Documented results, not bugs — never fake/suppress.

RULES: no suppression; A/A/A bit-determinism is the gate (+ parity vs canonical/eager, SG-family ~3e-5, fp32 storage); single-source math; no CUDA graphs.
BUILD: `python setup.py build_ext --inplace` (sccache wired via the nvcc shim; TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/workspace/.torch_ext exec-able). Export `TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/workspace/.torch_ext TMPDIR=/dev/shm/tmp`.
GATES (CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/nonexistent): tail-gate (existing 30 stay green + each new mamba cell PASS + A/A/A bit-deterministic); wiring_check --require-all (count 30 -> 32 or 33).
COMMIT locally per verified-green batch (SG11/15 mamba as one commit; SG2/mamba separately) — raw evidence in the message, end: Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>.
RETURN: raw gate output (the A/A/A determinism result for EACH new mamba cell), the new count, diff summary, build wall-time, and honest notes (which un-dormanted vs stayed dormant + why; the won't-grok caveats).

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. # SG2 -> L3-TC — builder spec (task #11). Decoder primary; vit delta; mamba DORMANT.
Last/hardest cell. The full SG2 meta-net is ALREADY BUILT (reuse, don't rebuild): sg2_meta_stages<Dims> (S0..S5 CSA/HCA/GRU/PEER/apply) in csrc/fused/sm_90/opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh, bound as sg2_meta_optimizer_tail (bindings.cpp:3599). Part-A fp64 parity GREEN (~1e-16, test_sg2_megakernel.py:96-135). OptId::SuperGrok2=10 exists (opt_components.cuh:56); current apply_optimizer<SuperGrok2> is just an Adam tail on st.smart_grad — NOT the meta-net.

## 4 deliverables
1. In-kernel SEGMENTED SORT (STAGE -1, the only big new device code): per-tensor in-CTA bitonic sort of [N] |grad| keys ascending; write perm/unsort before S0. TIE TRAP: torch.sort on CUDA is UNSTABLE — reproduce THAT order, NOT argsort(stable). RECOMMENDED strategy A: tie-break by index (comparator (|g|,idx)) on BOTH the device sort AND the oracle's perm builder (keep supergrok2_sm90.cuh:1642 in lock-step) -> deterministic + A/A/A-clean by construction. Add key/index scratch (+2*Nmax) to sg2_ws_stride (opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh:425) + carve. Add a tie-probe sub-test.
2. COMPOSE the meta-net into the model megakernel (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh, guard `if constexpr (Opt==SuperGrok2)`): after P2 reduce + B2 -> add SuperGrok2 to the P2.4 SAM guard (:546-547, REUSE — it writes st.sharpness=(g_sam-g)^2 and restores params); stage meta weights to smem (sg2_stage_weights); segmented sort (STAGE -1) from the fresh grad; inline sg2_meta_stages per tensor INSTEAD of apply_optimizer (drain the reset queue; drop the standalone's trailing bar.sync). Workspace: append dec_tc_sg2_floats as the LAST term (carve-last => 6 green cells byte-identical).
3. WIRE sharpness: point sg2_meta_stages' sharp_base at st.sharpness (the SAM-written (g_sam-g)^2); drop the external sharpness_packed arg on the fused path.
4. ROUTING: dispatch.cpp wgmma_tail_opt_id supergrok2 -> 10 (was -1, :621); mega_{decoder,vit}_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu add `case OptId::SuperGrok2` + bind the FULL SG2 state [m|v|mu|slow|gru_state(total*GH)|loss|sharpness|perm|unsort|meta-bundle|per-tensor-scalars] + bump min_state; dispatch.py add (transformer_decoder/vit, supergrok2) to _FUSED_L3_REAL(:667) + _L3_WGMMA_CELLS(:1411) + fused_train_step do_sam cadence + SG2 scalars. Route SG2 through the TC launcher, NOT the surrogate mega_vit_supergrok2.cu (surrogate model, not the race path). NOTE: per-tensor scalars (alpha/gru_decay/lamb/betas, opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh:301-312) DON'T fit the global FusedScalars — thread per-tensor scalar BUFFERS via state/workspace (same wall grokadamw's per-tensor clip hit).

## ViT: near-mechanical twin (fused_vit_megakernel.cuh, same recipe + launcher case).
## Mamba: LAND DORMANT (code-present, gated OUT of _L3_WGMMA_CELLS) — SAM double-forward + segmented sort re-trips the shared-mamba-forward A/A/A race (like mamba×prodigy, dispatch.py:788-805). Don't route until the in-progress race fix lands + A/A/A confirmed.

## HONEST CAVEAT — won't grok (blocks grok, NOT single-step parity)
In-kernel CSA lightning-indexer keeps qI/kI in low-rank indexer_rank space, DROPS idx_UQ, scores /sqrt(rank) (supergrok2.h:217-229, :493-512; idx_UQ void :510). The fp64 bilevel ORACLE lifts qI to full d via idx_UQ + /sqrt(d) (supergrok2_bilevel_adjoint.h:156-157). So the kernel diverges from the eager-TRAINED net for N>64. RESULT: single-step parity vs the per-op oracle (ops.supergrok2_batched_step — uses the SAME low-rank indexer, internally consistent) is ACHIEVABLE; GROKKING is NOT (needs idx_UQ + /sqrt(d) restored — separate fix, out of scope). Gate includes an N>64 CSA fidelity PROBE that REPORTS the divergence (not a regression).

## Gate plan
(B1) single-step: TC megakernel vs ops.supergrok2_batched_step, max|Δ{param,m,v,mu,slow,gru_state}| < 1e-5 (GRU/PEER hand-dot vs cuBLAS fp32-reorder tol, not 1e-12). (B2) 200-step trajectory < 1e-5. fp64 ~3e-5 fp32-storage. A/A/A bit-determinism (decoder/vit expected clean via the index-tie-break sort; mamba flagged). N>64 CSA fidelity probe (report divergence vs the bilevel oracle's full-d indexer). Single-source: all device blocks called from supergrok2.h / adjoint from supergrok2_bilevel_adjoint.h.

## Top risks
1. Sort tie-semantics (HIGHEST) — strategy A + lock-step oracle perm builder + tie probe. Wrong => silent CSA/HCA drift over the trajectory.
2. Occupancy/smem — SG2's ~9KB bundle + decoder DecActs/dW/SAM scratch; re-measure regs/smem, occupancy>=1 or the GridBarrier hangs.
3. Per-tensor scalars don't fit FusedScalars — thread buffers via state/workspace.
4. N>64 grok gap — scope honesty (single-step parity yes, grok no).
5. Mamba A/A/A race — land dormant.
6. State sizing — bump launcher min_state for SG2's large persisted block.

===HANDOFF===
# HANDOFF — SuperGrok1.5 H100 megakernel campaign

**For a fresh session:** read `MEMORY.md` (auto-loads, 14 standing rules), then run
`CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/nonexistent python wiring_check.py --require-all` for live
per-cell state, then `cat results/h100_grokking_race/roofline.json` for perf. This
file captures only what those can't: in-flight granularity + open decisions.

## State (2026-06-11, commit 405654f)
- **~18/33 cells real L3-TC wgmma** (wiring_check is the source of truth, not this number).
  Done: adamw/lion/grokfast/grokadamw/neuralgrok/prodigy across models; vit also muon.
  Blocked-with-reason (printed by wiring_check): the staged SAM optimizers
  (supergrok11/15, looksam) on decoder+mamba; neuralgrok/decoder shows "eager" until
  its committed cell rebuilds into _ops; mamba muon/sg2.
- **Component model:** 14 files (3 model stage headers `model_stage_<model>_tc.cuh` +
  11 opt tails) compose into 33 generated cells. Fix a header → recompose, never edit
  cells. Build: `FORCE_CUDA=1 ./build.sh` (or compile.py incremental; `*_selftest.cu`
  /`*_tc_launcher.cu` auto-excluded from `_ops` by setup.py content-filter).

## Headline perf (B=16384, quiet GPU)
- mamba TC: **0.46×→2.15× vs scalar** (bottleneck FIXED, the win)
- vit TC: **+3.48×, 4.60 TF/s** (3 structural bugs fixed: acc-array spill, 132× redundant
  bias reduce, strided clspos scan)
- decoder grokadamw: 3-mechanism cell landed (per-layer β1, global clip P2.5, adaptive α)
- **Absolute roofline fraction stays ~0.2–0.6% of bf16 peak — this is PHYSICS of tiny
  models, not missing optimization** (see "Roofline reality" below). Relative wins are real.

## In-flight when this was written (these agents die with the session)
- Wave-2 workflow (wf_694d43eb-253): 3 lanes converting remaining staged cells.
  decoder: muon→sg11→sg15→looksam→sg2. mamba: prodigy→muon→sg11→sg15→looksam→sg2 +
  fix mamba determinism gate fails. vit lane: DONE (committed 0cd63c8).
- Resume the campaign: per cell → tail_gate(state+A/A/A) + wiring_check + roofline quiet,
  maxed before next, blocked=loud+cited, commit per batch. Templates proven in vit lane.

## Open decisions for the owner
1. **mamba×adamw default = wgmma** (TC-only rule) but TC was 0.46× scalar pre-fix; now
   2.15× so the flip is justified — confirm it stays.
2. **Phase-decomposition** (offered, not yet run): clock64 instrumentation in the decoder
   TC kernel can break each cell's wall into GEMM/attention/elementwise/optimizer/barrier
   — tells the TRUE achievable ceiling per cell. Run before declaring cells "maxed".
3. **Scale-up vs optimize** (owner's live question): the roofline bars are low because the
   models are tiny (d=128, seq 4-17, 0.4M params, ~45µs math/step), NOT because kernels
   are unoptimized. Raising the bars meaningfully = bigger models/problem, which changes
   the experiment. Owner deciding whether that's in scope.

## Roofline reality (so a fresh session doesn't re-discover it)
- Roofline numerator = torch.profiler GEMM/conv FLOPs only; elementwise counts ZERO.
  These models are mostly NOT GEMM (tiny seq → scalar attention; LN/softmax/CE/optimizer
  are memory-bound) → even perfect GEMMs read low-% of the flat 989 TF/s peak.
- One-CTA-per-SM cooperative megakernels saturate at B≈2k, decline past 16k → max batch
  helps GEMM size but not occupancy. Multi-CTA-per-tensor tiling is the open lever.

## Provisioning (owner cost-optimal): signal mi300x+TPU at race-launch (pinned checkout).
gfx942 + TPU pre-silicon lanes committed (D1 + Pallas interpret 229-green); day-1 = bring-up.

## Earlier roofline measurement TRAP (don't repeat): a chart once measured eager+L1
because the bf16 precision gate declined L3. wiring_check.py exists to prevent this —
ALWAYS run it before any roofline; a row's `path`/`l3_engine` must say wgmma.

36	// `opt_id` selects the kernel instantiation over the SAME [m|v|extra]+loss state
37	// buffer (ema = extra slice for grokfast; the neuralgrok psi-net pack would live at
38	// the head of extra). The STAGED/model-coupled/SG2 optimizers are NOT cases (no
39	// single-launch TC path); dispatch.cpp gates them out and an unsupported id returns

43	// GEMMs; the scan/conv stay scalar by design — REUSED verbatim), validated by

55	// Persistent barrier/queue counters + the TC activations/grad workspace, cached
56	// per device. Mirrors mega_{decoder,vit}_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu's scratch but
57	// for mamba's workspace shape. Raw cudaMalloc (process-lived scratch, recreated
58	// only when a larger B needs a bigger workspace; never freed — one per device,
59	// leaked at process exit like every cuBLAS/cuDNN handle).
60	struct MbTcLauncherScratch {
61	    int*      g_next = nullptr;        // int [1]
62	    unsigned* g_arrived = nullptr;     // unsigned [1]
63	    unsigned* g_generation = nullptr;  // unsigned [1]
64	    float*    workspace = nullptr;     // float [mb_tc_workspace_floats(T, nCTA)]
65	    int64_t   ws_floats = 0;
66	    int       dev = -1;
67	};
68	
69	MbTcLauncherScratch& mb_tc_launcher_scratch(int dev, int64_t need_floats) {
70	    static MbTcLauncherScratch s;
71	    if (s.dev != dev) {
72	        s.dev = dev;
73	        if (!s.g_next)       cudaMalloc(&s.g_next, sizeof(int));
74	        if (!s.g_arrived)    cudaMalloc(&s.g_arrived, sizeof(unsigned));
75	        if (!s.g_generation) cudaMalloc(&s.g_generation, sizeof(unsigned));
76	    }
77	    if (s.ws_floats < need_floats) {
78	        if (s.workspace) cudaFree(s.workspace);
79	        cudaMalloc(&s.workspace, (size_t)need_floats * sizeof(float));
80	        s.ws_floats = need_floats;
81	    }
82	    return s;
83	}
84	}  // anonymous namespace
85	
86	// mega_mamba_real_adamw_tc — the WIRED Mamba TC launcher. Boundary mirrors the scalar
87	// mega_mamba_real_adamw (dispatch.cpp extern-decls it with the same mirror types)
88	// EXCEPT it takes NO workspace pointer: the TC workspace is a different size from the
89	// scalar partials, so this TU allocates+owns it. `loss_out` still points into the
90	// caller's state[3*total] slot (dispatch reads it back). `opt_id` selects the tail.
91	//
92	// ncta_cap: forwarded to the TC launcher (0 = one CTA/SM = full saturation, the
93	// shipped config). The race always passes 0.
94	cudaError_t mega_mamba_real_adamw_tc(
95	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
96	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
97	        float* state, float* grad, float* /*workspace_unused*/, float* loss_out,
98	        float lr, int step, const FusedScalars& scalars, cudaStream_t stream,
99	        int ncta_cap, int opt_id) {
100	    const int64_t total = kMambaTotalElems;
101	    const int T = B * mb::kSeq;
102	
103	    int dev = 0;
104	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
105	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
106	    int n_sms = 1;
107	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
108	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
109	    // Size the workspace for the EXACT count the kernel launcher runs (occ·n_sms with
110	    // the occupancy-fill default; reg-capped uniform across OptIds, so AdamW's count
111	    // == every tail's). Falls back to n_sms if the occ query fails.
112	    int nCTA = mb_tc_launched_nctas<OptId::AdamW>(dev, ncta_cap);
113	    if (nCTA <= 0) { nCTA = n_sms; if (ncta_cap > 0 && ncta_cap < nCTA) nCTA = ncta_cap; }
114	
115	    const int64_t need = mb_tc_workspace_floats(T, nCTA);
116	    MbTcLauncherScratch& sc = mb_tc_launcher_scratch(dev, need);
117	
118	    // Re-point the ctx counters at THIS TU's cached counters (the TC launcher zeroes
119	    // them per-launch, but they must be the ones this scratch owns so the grid
120	    // barrier is consistent with the workspace).
121	    ctx.g_next_task  = sc.g_next;
122	    ctx.g_arrived    = sc.g_arrived;
123	    ctx.g_generation = sc.g_generation;
124	    ctx.n_tasks      = kMambaNumTensors;   // parameter tensors for reduce+opt phases
125	
126	    // Bind the optimizer state slices. [m | v | extra] over the SAME state buffer;
127	    // each tail reads only its own buffers (opt_components.cuh guarantees unused
128	    // pointers are never dereferenced). ema/psi-net live in the `extra` slice.
129	    float* const extra_slice = state + 2 * total;
130	    FusedOptState st;
131	    st.exp_avg    = state;
132	    st.exp_avg_sq = state + total;
133	    st.ema        = extra_slice;          // grokfast/grokadamw slow-grad EMA
134	    st.psi_W1     = extra_slice + kPsiW1Off;   // neuralgrok psi-net pack (when wired)
135	    st.psi_b1     = extra_slice + kPsiB1Off;
136	    st.psi_W2     = extra_slice + kPsiW2Off;
137	    // PRODIGY (STAGED global-d) state bindings (mirror the decoder/vit TC launchers).
138	    // The cell extends the state buffer to [m | v | extra/s_track | loss | param_init |
139	    // r_ema | s_ema | d_lr] (host sizes it >= 4*total+4; dispatch.fused_train_step). The
140	    // `extra` slice doubles as Prodigy's `s` trajectory accumulator (the apply reads
141	    // st.s_track, not st.ema — they alias here, harmless: Prodigy has no slow-grad EMA).
142	    // loss_out == dispatch's loss_slot (state+3*total), so param_init = loss_out+1 and
143	    // the 3 persisted estimator scalars [r_ema | s_ema | d_lr] follow param_init.
144	    st.s_track        = extra_slice;            // Prodigy `s` (per-element accumulator)
145	    st.param_init     = loss_out + 1;           // state + 3*total + 1
146	    st.prodigy_persist = loss_out + 1 + total;  // [r_ema | s_ema | d_lr]
147	    // LookSAM (MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward) — the Mamba twin of the decoder/vit TC
148	    // launchers' sam_dir binding. sam_dir is the PERSISTENT cached SAM direction
149	    // (g_sam − g), carried across steps in the `extra` slice (aliases the grokfast EMA /
150	    // Prodigy s_track slot — harmless: LookSAM has none of those). The in-kernel P2.4
151	    // phase WRITES it on SAM steps (st.looksam_sam!=0); the apply tail READS it every step.
152	    st.sam_dir        = extra_slice;            // [total] cached SAM direction
153	    apply_scalars(st, scalars);   // FULL scalar set (un-frozen bc1/bc2/... + d0/d_coef/beta3 + rho/looksam_sam)
154	    st.lr = lr;
155	
156	    MambaTokenCtx tok;
157	    tok.tokens    = tokens;
158	    tok.targets   = targets;
159	    tok.B         = B;
160	    tok.workspace = sc.workspace;
161	    tok.loss_out  = loss_out;
162	
163	    // Dispatch to the matching kernel instantiation. The fwd+bwd is identical across
164	    // these OptIds; the template differs ONLY in the P3 apply_optimizer<Opt> tail.
165	    // Unsupported opt_ids return cudaErrorInvalidValue → dispatch.cpp throws LOUD.
166	    switch (static_cast<OptId>(opt_id)) {
167	        case OptId::AdamW:
168	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::AdamW>(
169	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
170	        case OptId::Lion:
171	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::Lion>(
172	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
173	        case OptId::Grokfast:
174	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::Grokfast>(
175	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
176	        case OptId::GrokAdamW:
177	            // 3-mechanism GrokAdamW (wave-2 mamba): the kernel's P2.5 global grad-norm
178	            // clip + P3 per-tensor layer-wise β1 land in fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<Opt>
179	            // (mirrors the decoder/vit TC kernels). γ/grad_clip thread through
180	            // FusedScalars (apply_scalars). ema = the `extra` slice (cold-start seed).
181	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::GrokAdamW>(
182	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
183	        case OptId::NeuralGrok:
184	            // psi-net MLP tail (wave-2 mamba): apply_optimizer<NeuralGrok> reads the
185	            // psi pack the host scattered into the `extra` slice (st.psi_W1/b1/W2 bound
186	            // above) + alpha/beta from FusedScalars. Pure elementwise — no precompute,
187	            // no cross-CTA reduction, so it inherits the deterministic grad reduce.
188	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::NeuralGrok>(
189	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
190	        case OptId::Prodigy:
191	            // STAGED global-d (wave-2 mamba): the SAME single persistent launch — the
192	            // cross-ALL-tensors d-estimate is an IN-KERNEL phase (P2.6, between the grad
193	            // reduce B2 and the apply P3), not a separate launch. st carries param_init/
194	            // prodigy_persist/d0/d_coef/beta3 (bound above); the mamba TC kernel decays+
195	            // accumulates the EMA, updates d, applies. The reduce slots are carved in
196	            // mb_tc_workspace_floats (mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats), so this scratch already fits.
197	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::Prodigy>(
198	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
199	        case OptId::LookSAM:
200	            // MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward (mamba SAM-tier lane): the SAME single
201	            // persistent launch — the perturb→2nd in-kernel fwd+bwd→sam_dir=g_sam−g is
202	            // an IN-KERNEL phase (P2.4, between B2 and P2.5/P3), gated to every-k SAM
203	            // steps by st.looksam_sam. The transient backup + g_sam buffers live in the
204	            // workspace (mb_tc_looksam_floats, carved after the Prodigy reduce slots);
205	            // sam_dir persists in the extra slice (st.sam_dir, bound above). The apply
206	            // tail (P3) blends g_adj=(1−α)g+α·sam_dir and runs AdamW. NOT a separate
207	            // launch. The decoder/vit twins proved this routing.
208	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::LookSAM>(
209	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
210	        case OptId::Muon:
211	            // STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz (mamba muon lane): the SAME single
212	            // persistent launch — the NS orthogonalization of the 13 2D weights (tok/pos/
213	            // A_log/in_proj/x_proj/dt_proj/out_proj × 2 layers + out.weight) is an IN-KERNEL
214	            // phase (P2.7, between B2/P2.6 and P3), grid-barrier-looped per matrix, NOT a
215	            // separate launch. The per-matrix NS scratch lives in the workspace
216	            // (mb_tc_muon_floats, carved after the LookSAM scratch). The persistent momentum
217	            // buffer is the m-slice (st.exp_avg, bound above); the 1D/non-2D weights take the
218	            // AdamW tail in P3 reading the INDEPENDENT aux_lr/aux_betas (eager Muon adamw_*
219	            // group, carried via apply_scalars). The decoder/vit twins proved this routing.
220	            // muon/mamba is a SINGLE forward + NS precompute (NOT a 2nd forward), so it does
221	            // NOT hit the shared mamba-forward A/A/A race that blocks the SAM-2nd-pass mamba
222	            // cells — VERIFIED A/A/A bit-exact by test_l3tc_tail_gate (muon/mamba).
223	            return launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId::Muon>(
224	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
225	        default:
226	            return cudaErrorInvalidValue;  // STAGED/coupled opt not single-launch TC
227	    }
228	}
229	
230	}}}  // namespace sg::fused::sm90

48	    unsigned* g_arrived = nullptr;    // unsigned [1]

55	DecTcLauncherScratch& dec_tc_launcher_scratch(int dev, int64_t need_floats) {

275	// kernel instantiation (its P3-SG2 phase runs sg2_meta_stages per tensor: STAGE -1

277	// SAM 2nd backward (P2.4, shared with SG11/15)).

280	//   [m(total) | v(total) | mu(total) | loss(1) | sharpness(total) | slow(total)
281	//    | gru_state(total*GH)]   ⇒ min_state = (4+1+GH)*total + 1   (GH=gru_hidden=4)
282	// perm/unsort are built IN-KERNEL into the per-CTA workspace (NOT state).

284	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
285	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
286	        float* state, float* grad, float* loss_out,
287	        // SG2 meta-net weight bundle (HBM, fp32, model-independent), in SG2Weights order.

289	        const float* csa_q_W, const float* csa_k_W, const float* csa_v_W, const float* csa_out_W,

292	        const float* gru_Wz, const float* gru_bz, const float* gru_Wr, const float* gru_br,
293	        const float* gru_Wh, const float* gru_bh,
294	        const float* peer_query_Ws, const float* prod_keys_A, const float* prod_keys_B,
295	        const float* expert_W1, const float* expert_b1, const float* expert_W2, const float* expert_b2,
296	        // per-tensor scalar arrays (device, length kDecNumTensors).
297	        const float* sc_alpha, const float* sc_gru_decay, const float* sc_lamb_eff,

328	    st.exp_avg_sq  = state + total;               // v

331	    float* sharp_base = loss_out + 1;             // state + 3*total + 1
332	    st.sharpness   = sharp_base;                  // (g_sam − g)² (SAM 2nd backward, P2.4)
333	    st.sg2_slow    = sharp_base + total;          // grokfast slow-grad EMA
334	    st.sg2_gru_state = st.sg2_slow + total;       // [total*GH] per-element GRU state
335	    // meta-net weight bundle (HBM).
336	    st.sg2_input_proj_W = input_proj_W; st.sg2_input_proj_b = input_proj_b;
337	    st.sg2_csa_q_W = csa_q_W; st.sg2_csa_k_W = csa_k_W; st.sg2_csa_v_W = csa_v_W;
338	    st.sg2_csa_out_W = csa_out_W; st.sg2_csa_compress_w = csa_compress_w;
339	    st.sg2_csa_idx_DQ = csa_idx_DQ; st.sg2_csa_idx_K = csa_idx_K;
340	    st.sg2_hca_q_W = hca_q_W; st.sg2_hca_k_W = hca_k_W; st.sg2_hca_v_W = hca_v_W;
341	    st.sg2_hca_out_W = hca_out_W;
342	    st.sg2_gru_Wz = gru_Wz; st.sg2_gru_bz = gru_bz; st.sg2_gru_Wr = gru_Wr;
343	    st.sg2_gru_br = gru_br; st.sg2_gru_Wh = gru_Wh; st.sg2_gru_bh = gru_bh;
344	    st.sg2_peer_query_Ws = peer_query_Ws; st.sg2_prod_keys_A = prod_keys_A;
345	    st.sg2_prod_keys_B = prod_keys_B;
346	    st.sg2_expert_W1 = expert_W1; st.sg2_expert_b1 = expert_b1;
347	    st.sg2_expert_W2 = expert_W2; st.sg2_expert_b2 = expert_b2;
348	    // per-tensor scalar arrays.
349	    st.sg2_alpha = sc_alpha; st.sg2_gru_decay = sc_gru_decay; st.sg2_lamb_eff = sc_lamb_eff;
350	    st.sg2_beta1 = sc_beta1; st.sg2_bc1 = sc_bc1; st.sg2_bc2 = sc_bc2;
351	    st.sg2_rescale = rescale;
352	    // shared scalars the SG2 phase reads (beta2/lr/wd/eps via FusedScalars fields).
353	    st.beta2 = beta2; st.lr = lr; st.wd = wd; st.eps = eps;
354	    // SAM 2nd-backward gate: SG2 reuses the LookSAM P2.4 machinery. st.rho is the
355	    // perturbation radius (SG2's sam_rho); st.looksam_sam is the every-k SAM-step gate
356	    // (1.0 ⇒ run the in-kernel perturb→2nd fwd+bwd→sharpness=(g_sam−g)² this step;
357	    // 0.0 ⇒ reuse the cached sharpness). On a non-SAM step the cached sharpness feeds

361	
362	    DecoderTokenCtx tok;
363	    tok.tokens    = tokens;
364	    tok.targets   = targets;

The occupancy-fill `waves = (min_blocks>=2 && occ>1) ? occ : 1`. With min_blocks=1 (the shipped default), `waves=1` always, so `launch_ctas = n_sms` regardless of occ.
